title: Convention for the Lease of the Liaotung Peninsula
text: The Convention for the Lease of the Liaotung Peninsula, also known as the Pavlov Agreement, is an unequal treaty signed between Alexander Pavlov of the Russian Empire and Li Hongzhang of the Qing dynasty of China on 27 March 1898. The treaty granted Russia the lease of Port Arthur (Lüshun) and permitted its railway to extend to the port from one of the points of the Chinese Eastern Railway (CER).
